title: dependency
symptoms: The existing parser reports dependency at the recorded tool stage
possible_causes: A conditional compilation branch references an unavailable module
inspection_steps: Inspect the reported module instance and available self-contained definitions
Check whether the failure is in simulation or synthesis
repair_guidance: Implement the required behavior within the authorized single DUT when consistent with the specification
limitations: Do not add external dependencies, includes or benchmark edits without authority
A synthesis-only missing module is not proof that simulation failed
